definitions.explanation: Having vivid, bright, and striking colors. Used to describe things that are visually impressive due to their rich coloring.

examples.japanese: {色鮮|いろあざ}やかな⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{咲|さ}いている→咲く：08150_saku⟧。
{色鮮|いろあざ}やかな⟦{着物|きもの}→着物：01309_kimono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}た→着る：00541_kiru⟧⟦{女性|じょせい}→女性：01617_josei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}いた→引く：01978_hiku⟧。
examples.english: A woman wearing a brightly colored kimono caught my eye.

examples.japanese: ⟦{秋|あき}→秋：02276_aki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{色鮮|いろあざ}やかな⟦{紅葉|こうよう}→紅葉：04151_kouyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{染|そ}まり→染まる：04254_somaru⟧、{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{観光客|かんこうきゃく}→観光客：03022_kankoukyaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{訪|おとず}れる→訪れる：07678_otozureru⟧。
examples.english: In autumn, the mountains are dyed with vivid fall colors, attracting many tourists.

notes:
USAGE:
{色鮮|いろあざ}やか is a compound of ⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧ (color) and ⟦{鮮|あざ}やか→鮮やか：05702_azayaka⟧ (vivid). It functions as a na-adjective, used with な before nouns and ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ before verbs.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {色鮮|いろあざ}やかな⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧ (colorful flowers)
- {色鮮|いろあざ}やかな⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧ (colorful dishes)
- {色鮮|いろあざ}やかな⟦{紅葉|こうよう}→紅葉：04151_kouyou⟧ (vivid autumn leaves)
- {色鮮|いろあざ}やか⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{彩|いろど}る→彩る：12542_irodoru⟧ (to color vividly)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦カラフル→カラフル：10803_karafuru⟧ (colorful) is a casual loanword alternative. ⟦{鮮|あざ}やか→鮮やか：05702_azayaka⟧ alone means "vivid" but can refer to skill or technique, not just color.
